questions.prompt: What year did Fenway Park open, making it the oldest active Major League Baseball stadium?
questions.npcReactionCorrect: April 20, 1912. Same week the Titanic sank. Stadium's survived everything since.
questions.npcReactionWrong: 1912. April 20th. This park's been standing longer than your grandparents. Show some respect.

questions.prompt: What's the name of the lone red seat in Fenway's right field bleachers, and what does it mark?
choices: Ted Williams' seat - marks the landing spot of his 502-foot home run
Babe Ruth's seat - marks his first Red Sox home run
Carl Yastrzemski's seat - marks his Triple Crown season
David Ortiz's seat - marks his 500th career home run
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Ted Williams. June 9, 1946. Longest home run in Fenway history. Guy whose head it hit got a free lifetime pass.
questions.npcReactionWrong: Ted Williams. 502 feet. Section 42, Row 37, Seat 21. Only red seat in the whole park. You shoulda known that.

questions.prompt: Before the Red Sox finally won the World Series in 2004, when was their last championship?
questions.npcReactionCorrect: 1918. Eighty-six years. Sully cried in '04. Said he was crying for his father. Then he cried again in '07, '13, and '18.
questions.npcReactionWrong: 1918. Eighty-six years of suffering. You want to talk about pain? That was pain.

questions.prompt: What is the height of the Green Monster (left field wall) in feet?
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Thirty-seven feet, two inches. Built in 1912. Wasn't always green—they painted it in 1947.
questions.npcReactionWrong: Thirty-seven feet. Everyone knows the Green Monster. Not everyone knows exactly how tall it is.

questions.prompt: What song has become Fenway's unofficial anthem, played during the 8th inning?
choices: Shipping Up to Boston by Dropkick Murphys
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Sweet Caroline. Started in 2002. Sully said it was 'sentimental garbage.' He sang it every time.
questions.npcReactionWrong: Sweet Caroline. Middle of the 8th, whole park starts singing. Neil Diamond himself has sung it here.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What was the nickname given to the supposed curse that prevented the Red Sox from winning after trading Babe Ruth?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: The Curse of the Bambino. Broken in 2004. We don't talk about the curse years anymore. Or we talk about them all the time.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: The Curse of the Bambino. They said this team was cursed. Had a name for it and everything.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What Red Sox player had the last .400 batting average in a single season (1941)?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Ted Williams. .406. Nobody's done it since. Nobody will.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: Ted Williams. Nobody's hit .400 since 1941. The last guy to do it was a legend.

alternateQuestions.prompt: The triangle in center field at Fenway has what unique feature?
choices: It has the deepest point in fair territory in the majors
It's the only grass-free zone in the outfield
It contains a hidden door to the bullpen
It has special drainage for the sprinkler system
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Deepest point in fair territory. Over 420 feet in the corners. Balls go there to die.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: The triangle out there is the deepest corner in baseball. Outfielders hate it. Pitchers love it.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What is the only number retired by the Red Sox for a player who never played for them?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: 42. Jackie Robinson. Retired across all of baseball. The Red Sox were the last team to integrate. That number reminds us.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: 42. Jackie Robinson's number. Retired league-wide. The Red Sox have a complicated history with that.

alternateQuestions.prompt: Who was the legendary left fielder known for playing off the Green Monster better than anyone?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Yaz. Knew every bounce off that wall. Played left field for over twenty years. Nobody did it better.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: Carl Yastrzemski. They called him Yaz. Played left field like he was born there. Knew every bounce off the Monster.

alternateQuestions.prompt: Fenway Park is located on what street, which was renamed in 2018?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Jersey Street. Used to be Yawkey Way. They changed it in 2018. The Yawkey name... complicated history.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: 4 Jersey Street now. They renamed it from Yawkey Way. Some names carry too much weight.

redemptionChallenge.instructions: Name 7 Red Sox players (any era) in 30 seconds.
redemptionChallenge.npcPassResponse: Alright, you know your roster. Sully would've added some guys from the '67 team, but I'll take it.
redemptionChallenge.npcFailResponse: You named five. Five! My grandmother could name ten and she thought baseball was 'men standing around.' Try again.
